responsibility: Implements the Rust builtin offset_of! macro handler in the expansion subsystem. This file reparses the invocation token tree with MacroInvocLexer and Parser, extracts and validates the required type and field arguments, emits diagnostics when either argument cannot be parsed, tolerates an optional trailing comma, and returns an AST::Fragment containing an AST::OffsetOf node so later Rust front-end stages can lower the builtin field-offset query.
